newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money rates could slip if guilder improves.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money rates could slip if guilder improves.

text.p: Dutch money rates were pretty much stuck in the mud on Monday as trade was thin with London closed and the guilder virtually unchanged against the mark.

"If the mark weakens somewhat more against the guilder, rates could ease further," said one dealer, adding the guilder remained close to Friday's 112.095 per 100 marks, trading at 112.09 in mid-afternoon.
The guilder has regained strength against the mark over a longer period as the Dutch currency was trading at around 112.22 two weeks ago.
Call money was unchanged at 2.62 percent bid.
Three-month deposits slipped two basis points to 2.82 percent bid.
One-year paper shed one basis point to 3.14 percent, though one dealer said he was in the middle of completing a deal at 3.21 percent bid.
